headline: Indian markets eye global cues as Asian stocks rise and oil prices drop; Elevate Campuses IPO in focus

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Asian stocks rose following a tech-led rally in US markets
Global crude oil prices have corrected, providing a positive trigger for Indian markets
The Indian Rupee strengthened to 95.59 against the dollar due to RBI intervention and lower oil costs
Elevate Campuses IPO saw strong interest, raising Rs 945 crore from anchor investors
whatHappening: 360 ONE WAM Group has appointed Aashish Agarwal as its new CEO
Weighted Average Call Rate (WACR) exceeded the repo rate for the first time in nearly two months
Gift Nifty and other Asian indices like Nikkei and Kospi are signaling the opening trend for the session
Liquidity conditions are shifting as certificate of deposit (CD) rates diverge amid rising rate hike bets
summary: Indian markets are set for a session influenced by positive Asian cues and a significant drop in oil prices. Corporate developments include a leadership change at 360 ONE WAM and strong anchor interest in the Elevate Campuses IPO. Investors are also monitoring tightening liquidity as the call rate surpasses the repo rate.
